content: Depit ketin wia Wadawad en Aramas
Sehdan men kahrehiong mehn Israel nan paisuwed, ihme e pangenki Depit en ketin wiahda ntingdien aramas koaros nan Israel.
Depit eri mahsanihong Sohap oh lapalap teiko, “Kumwail kohwei nan Israel, sang apali wehi lel apali, oh wadekedi aramas akan, I men ese uwen tohtohn aramas akan.”

Sohap eri sapeng, patohwan, “Maing, Wasa Lapalap, KAUN-O en ketin katohtohwehla mehn Israel pak epwiki tohtohsang rahnwet! Irail koaros iei sapwellimomwi ladu. Dahme komwi kupwurkihki wia irair wet me pahn kahrehiong wehiet pwon nan dihp?”
Ahpw nanmwarkio nantihengete Sohap en kapwaiada sapwellime koasoandi. Sohap eri patopatohla, e seiloaklahng wasa koaros nan wehin Israel, oh pil pwurodohng nan Serusalem.
E pakairkihong Nanmwarki Depit uwen tohtohn ohl akan me kak wia doadoahk en sounpei: ohl 1,100,000 en Israel oh 470,000 en Suda.
Pwehki Sohap eh sapwungki sapwellimen nanmwarkio koasoandi, e sohte ntingihedi kadaudok en Lipai oh Pensamin.
Koht sohte ketin kupwurperenki irair wet, e ahpw ketin kalokehki mehn Israel.
Depit eri patohwanohng Koht, “Maing, I patohwan wiadahr dihp lapalap ehu ni ei wiadahr met! Komwi ketin kupwur mahkohng ie. I wiadahr tiahk en pweipwei ehu.”
KAUN-O eri ketin mahsanihong Kad, sapwellimen Depit soukohpo,
“Kohwei padahkihong Depit me I pahn kihong pilipil siluh. I pahn kapwaiada dahme e pahn pilada.”
Kad eri patohla rehn Depit, padahkihong dahme KAUN-O mahsanih, e ahpw idek, “Mehnia rehn soahng siluh pwukat me komwi pahn ketin pilada?

Lehk lapalap soupar siluh? De komwi en tangatangasang karis en sapwellimomwi imwintihti kan erein sounpwong siluh? De erein rahn siluh KAUN-O en ketin mahwenkihong komwi sapwellime kedlahs oh ketikidohng pohn wehiet soumwahu lusulus, ni eh pahn ketikidohng sapwellime tohnleng kan en kemehla aramas akan nan wehiet pwon? Ia pasapeng me I pahn patohwanohng KAUN-O?”
Depit ahpw ketin sapengki Kad, “I mihier nan apwal laud! Ahpw I sohte men ale lokolok sang rehn aramas. KAUN-O en pein ketin kaloke ie, pwehki ih me ketin kupwurkalahngan.”
KAUN-O eri ketin kadarodo soumwahu lusulus ong mehn Israel, oh aramas isinen me mehkihla.

E ahpw ketin kadarodo tohnleng men pwehn kamwomwala Serusalem, ahpw e pil ketin wekidala kupwure oh mahsanihong tohnlengo, “Erier! Itarehr!” Ni ahnsowo tohnlengo kesikesihnen ni en Arauana, mehn Sepus, e wasahn kamwakele kohn.
Depit eri mahsanihada tohnlengo eh kesikesihnen nan wehwe, kolokol nah kedlahs, onopadahr en kamwomwala Serusalem. Depit oh kaunen aramas akan—koaros mi nan likoun nsensuwed—poaridi lel nanpwel.

Depit ahpw loulou, mahsanih, “Maing Koht, ngehi me wiadahr sapwung wet. Ngehi me wiahda koasoandien ntingdien aramas wet. Dahme aramas pwukat wiadahr? Maing KAUN, ei Koht, komwi ketin kaloke ngehi oh ei peneinei, a komwi dehr ketin kaloke sapwellimomwi aramas akan.”
Tohnleng en KAUN-O ahpw padahkihong Kad en koasoanediong Depit en kauwada ehu pei sarawi ong KAUN-O ni en Arauana wasahn kamwakele kohno.
Depit eri kapwaiada mahsen en KAUN-O, nin duwen me Kad patohwanohngehr.
Arauana oh nah pwutak pahmen ko mihmi ni wasahn kamwakel kohn ni ahnsou me re kilangada tohnlengo, nah pwutak ko eri tangdoaui oh rukula.
Ni ahnsou me Arauana kilangada Nanmwarki Depit eh ketiket kohdo, e ahpw pweieklahsang wasahn kamwakele kohno oh poaridi lel nanpwel.

Depit ahpw mahsanihong, “Komw netikidohng ie omwi wasahn kamwakel kohn en, pwe I en kak kauwada ehu pei sarawi ong KAUN-O, pwehn katokihedi soumwahu lusulus wet, I pahn pwainohng komwi uwen pweine pwon.”

Arauana eri sapeng, patohwan, “Wasa Lapalap en ketikihda wasaht oh ketin wiahiong dahme re ketin kupwukupwure. Iet kou kan mehn wia meirong isihs pohn pei sarawio, oh iet dinapw en kamwakel kan mehn wia tuwi, oh wahn kohn mehn meirong. I patohwanohng komwi mepwukat koaros.”
Ahpw nanmwarkio ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Soh, I pahn pwaihnohng komwi soahng koaros. I sohte pahn meirongkihong KAUN-O mehkot me ahmw, mehkot me I sohte pahn medengki.”
Ih eri ketikihong Arauana pweinen wasao me iei mwohni kohl wenepwiki.

E ahpw ketin kauwada pei sarawi ehu wasao ong KAUN-O, oh wiahda meirong isihs oh meirong en kaminimin. E ahpw loulou, oh KAUN-O ketin kupwure eh pekipek ni eh ketin kadaridi kisiniei pohn pei sarawio oh isikala meirong ko.
KAUN-O eri ketin mahsanihong tohnlengo en pwilikihdi nah kedlahso, tohnlengo eri kapwaiada.
Depit eri mwahngihada sang ni mwekid wet me KAUN-O ketin karongeier eh pekipek, ih eri wiahda meirong kei pohn pei sarawio, ni en Arauana wasahn kamwakel kohno.
Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale me Moses wiahda nan sapwtehno, oh pei sarawi me meirong kan kin isihsla powe mihmihte wasahn kaudok nan Kipeon ni ahnsowo;
ahpw Depit sohte kak ketilahng wasao pwehn kaudokiong Koht, pwehki eh masak kedlahs en tohnleng en KAUN-O.
